title: Hands on: generate a nullifier
instructions: Complete the documented Compact circuit by calling the secret-key witness; the round scopes the one-time action.
successCriteria: Fill the blank with secretKey(). Same secret plus same round is rejected; the same secret plus a new round is allowed.

title: Hands on: verify uniqueness
instructions: Complete the Compact membership check in the complete round-scoped circuit.
successCriteria: Fill the blank with member; the simulation models the Set state locally and is not blockchain execution.

title: Hands on: round-scoped nullifier
instructions: Complete the round-scoping fragment so the same secret can act once per round.
successCriteria: Fill the blank with round; same secret and same round is rejected, while a new round is allowed.

title: Hands on: register the nullifier
instructions: Complete the Compact ledger operation that records the disclosed nullifier after the membership check.
